audiospeed_oracle: CircuitPython 10.2.1 source plus MicroPython executable regression

aarch64.evidence: 6 of 744 numeric fields differ from the x86_64 reference; largest absolute deviation 1, confined to multitap (5 fields) and pitchshift (1); phaser, chorus, freeverb and speed identical, and the 16 real decoded samples on the phaser_samples line identical. CORRECTED 2026-09-03: an earlier version of this note inferred '1 LSB, about -90 dBFS' from the sum delta. That inference is false -- the fields are sum(data) over UNSIGNED BYTES, so a delta of 1 is equally consistent with one sample off by +257 and another by -256 (planted and demonstrated, audioif fault-planting pass 2026-09-02). The sum bounds nothing about sample error. This acceptance therefore rests on Brad's rule (bit-identity within an architecture, not across) and on the 16 decoded samples matching, not on the delta magnitude. See the effects-gate issues filed 2026-09-03.
